description: Submits an order for the traveller with their consent. No payment is taken: Shuttlely confirms availability by email, then sends a deposit link. Returns an order number.

agentName.description: Which assistant or agent is booking, for the operator

requestId.description: Generate once per order; resending the same id never creates a second order

traveller.description: Who is travelling and where Shuttlely should write

email.description: Confirmation and the deposit link go here

name.description: The traveller's name as they give it: a plain name, no links or email addresses

phone.description: Optional phone number with country code, for the driver on the day

travellerConsent.description: True only after the traveller agreed to book and to https://shuttlely.ca/en/terms

trip.description: The same trip that was priced with get_quote

airportDropoff.description: Optional airport drop-off, by default the morning after the last touring day

zone.description: Where in Toronto; "other" gets a written quote

airportPickup.description: Optional airport pickup on the start date; touring starts the next morning

zone.description: Where in Toronto; "other" gets a written quote

bags.description: Checked suitcases and carry-ons; helps pick a vehicle with room for them

childAges.description: Ages of the children among the guests; car seats are free

customDays.description: A custom route from Toronto: one short line per day in the traveller's words. Always a written quote.

dropoffDate.description: With airportDropoff: the flight-home date if later than the standard drop-off

extraHoursPerDay.description: Extra hours per touring day beyond the included 10

guests.description: Guests including children; 1-7 can price instantly

routes.description: Toronto route slugs from list_routes, in travel order. Use routes or customDays, not both.

startDate.description: First service day, YYYY-MM-DD, Toronto time; up to about 18 months ahead

vehicleClass.description: Optional; defaults to the smallest class that fits

name: place_order
title: Book a Toronto trip
